criteria.rationale: The deliverable accurately applies the operative commercial plan from record-17.txt (110,000 packs per year over 5 years) based on the approval status in registry.txt, while explicitly noting and excluding the unapproved draft in record-22.txt (150,000 packs). All cost and savings calculations in INR at USD 1 = INR 83 are arithmetically exact: current assembly (INR 107,900) plus overhead (INR 16,600) equals INR 124,500; localised assembly (INR 20,000) plus overhead (INR 590) equals INR 20,590; unit saving is INR 103,910 (reducing total unit cost from INR 830,000 to INR 726,090); annual saving is INR 11,430,100,000; and five-year saving is INR 57,150,500,000. Unresolved items (such as capex and cost validation) are properly framed as assumptions and next steps awaiting CPO approval rather than completed actions.

evidence.output_quote: The operative commercial plan (record-17, approved) projects 110,000 packs a year for 5 years, or 550,000 packs in total. A draft record showing 150,000 packs is unapproved and was excluded.

evidence.source_quote: Currently the battery is 10,000 USD per battery pack (830,000 INR, at USD=83INR) inclusive of all costs. Of these costs, 1300 USD is for assembly costs, and 200 USD is for overheads. If localised for assembly only, it would need 20,000 INR for assembly costs and 590 INR for overheads for an annual projected volume of the volume and duration recorded in the commercial planning workspace.
evidence.output_quote: Cost: unit cost falls from INR 830,000 to INR 726,090, a reduction of about 12.5%.

criteria.consequence: None; all figures, authority decisions, and proposed actions are consistent with the source records.

criteria.rationale: The Word document covers all required elements of the partnership proposal for the CPO: the 49:51 EvTronics:EV Batteries Inc. joint venture structure with technical oversight by EV Batteries Inc. and Delhi-based assembly operations led by EvTronics; the child-part sourcing model; expected volumes and INR cost-saving calculations; key benefits (PMP and FAME II regulatory compliance, unit cost reduction, and reduced forex exposure); key risks (imported cell dependency, coordination complexity, unquantified initial capex, and volume/cost assumptions); a phased localisation roadmap aligned with PMP Phases 1 to 4; and clear recommendations and next steps.

evidence.source_quote: Proposed Partnership structure is a 49:51::EvTronics:EV Batteries Inc. split in which EV Batteries Inc. would retain technical oversight and EvTronics leads assembly and local operations from Delhi.
evidence.output_quote: A joint venture would be owned 49% by EvTronics and 51% by EV Batteries Inc. EV Batteries Inc. keeps technical oversight, covering design, quality standards and process certification. EvTronics leads assembly and local operations from Delhi, including the plant, workforce, local supply chain and delivery to our plant.

evidence.source_quote: Under this arrangement, EV Batteries Inc. would supply child parts— cells, housing, thermal systems, battery management system, connectors—to EvTronics, which would then assemble the battery packs locally and supply them to your plant.
evidence.output_quote: EV Batteries Inc. supplies child parts to the Delhi unit: cells, housing, thermal systems, battery management system (BMS) and connectors. EvTronics assembles and tests the packs and supplies them to our plant. All component costs other than assembly and overhead stay at current pricing.

evidence.source_quote: Highlight the key benefits such as regulatory compliance, long-term cost reduction (reduced forex exposure), as well as the main risks including dependency on imported cells, coordination complexity, and initial capex. Include expected EV production volumes, a phased localisation timeline, and clear recommendations for next steps.
evidence.output_quote: 1. Obtain CPO approval to open JV term-sheet discussions with both partners.

criteria.consequence: None; the deliverable addresses all prompt requirements for the target executive audience.

task_defect.reason: The request and workspace records are unambiguous and mutually consistent with the document registry rules.

assessment_normalized.caveat: No weighted average can offset a critical failure. Exact quotes establish traceability, not entailment. Rendering and independent human calibration remain required.
